035/**
036 * EditFragment is a BottomSheetDialogFragment that provides editing functionality for a
037 * Pin object. This class manages the interaction between the UI, ViewModels, and system
038 * resources to allow users to edit and save pin attributes.
039 *
040 * It includes the following responsibilities:
041 * - Displaying the details of a Pin object, such as title, content, and image.
042 * - Allowing the user to update the Pin's title, content, image, and location.
043 * - Handling camera permissions and initiating image capture.
044 * - Observing and interacting with LiveData from various ViewModels.
045 *
046 * This fragment utilizes data binding to bind UI elements to corresponding data processes
047 * and ViewModels for core business logic.
048 */
049@AndroidEntryPoint
050public class EditFragment extends BottomSheetDialogFragment {
051
052  private static final String TAG = EditFragment.class.getSimpleName();
053  private static final String AUTHORITY = ImageFileProvider.class.getName().toLowerCase();
054
055  private FragmentEditBinding binding;
056  private PinViewModel pinViewModel;
057  private PermissionsViewModel permissionsViewModel;
058  private LocationViewModel locationViewModel;
059  private long pinId;
060  private Pin pin;
061  private ActivityResultLauncher<Uri> captureLauncher;
062  private Uri uri;
063  private Location location;
064
065  @Override
066  public void onCreate(@Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
067    super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
068    pinId = EditFragmentArgs.fromBundle(getArguments()).getPinId();
069    // Read any input arguments.
070  }
071
072  @NonNull
073  @Override
074  public Dialog onCreateDialog(@Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
075    // TODO: 2/18/25 Inflate layout and construct & return dialog containing layout.
076    return super.onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState);
077  }
078
079  @Nullable
080  @Override
081  public View onCreateView(@NonNull LayoutInflater inflater, @Nullable ViewGroup container,
082      @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
083    // Return root element of layout.
084    binding = FragmentEditBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false);
085    // Attach listeners to UI widgets.
086    binding.cancel.setOnClickListener((v) -> dismiss());
087    binding.save.setOnClickListener((v) -> save());
088    binding.capture.setOnClickListener((v) -> capture());
089    return binding.getRoot();
090  }
091
092  @Override
093  public void onViewCreated(@NonNull View view, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
094    super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState);
095    // Connect to viewmodel(s) and observe LiveData.
096    FragmentActivity activity = requireActivity();
097    ViewModelProvider provider = new ViewModelProvider(activity);
098    pinViewModel = provider.get(PinViewModel.class);
099    LifecycleOwner owner = getViewLifecycleOwner();
100    if (pinId != 0) {
101      pinViewModel.fetch(pinId);
102      pinViewModel
103          .getPin()
104          .observe(owner, this::handlePin);
105    } else {
106      binding.image.setVisibility(View.GONE);
107      pin = new Pin();
108      uri = null;
109      pinViewModel.clearCaptureUri();
110    }
111    pinViewModel
112        .getCaptureUri()
113        .observe(owner, this::handleCaptureUri);
114    locationViewModel = provider.get(LocationViewModel.class);
115    getLifecycle().addObserver(locationViewModel);
116    locationViewModel.getLocation()
117        .observe(owner, location -> {
118          this.location = location;
119          Log.d(TAG, "Location: " + location);
120          // TODO: 3/31/25 Do something with the location. Probably store it in the location embedded field.
121
122        });
123    permissionsViewModel = provider.get(PermissionsViewModel.class);
124    permissionsViewModel
125        .getPermissionsStatus()
126        .observe(owner, (permissions) -> {
127          //noinspection DataFlowIssue
128          binding.capture.setVisibility(permissions.getOrDefault(permission.CAMERA, false) ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
129          if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(permissions.getOrDefault(permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, false))) {
130            locationViewModel.startService();
131          }
132        });
133    captureLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
134        new ActivityResultContracts.TakePicture(), pinViewModel::confirmCapture);
135  }
136
137  @Override
138  public void onDestroyView() {
139    binding = null; // Set binding reference(s) to null.
140    super.onDestroyView();
141  }
142
143  /**
144   * @noinspection DataFlowIssue
145   */
146  /**
147   * Saves the current state of the pin object by updating its title, content, image, and optionally
148   * its location, and passing the updated object to the appropriate ViewModel for persistence.
149   * The method performs the following steps:
150   * 1. Extracts and trims user-provided title and content from the UI and updates the pin object.
151   * 2. Sets the associated image for the pin.
152   * 3. If a location is provided, it creates a {@code Location} object with latitude and longitude values
153   *    and assigns it to the pin.
154   * 4. Invokes the ViewModel's save method to persist the changes.
155   * 5. Closes the current dialog or view after saving.
156   *
157   * Note: The handling of created and modified timestamps is pending implementation.
158   */
159  private void save() {
160    pin.setTitle(binding.title
161        .getText()
162        .toString()
163        .strip());
164    pin.setContent(binding.content
165        .getText()
166        .toString()
167        .strip());
168    pin.setImage(uri);
169    if (location != null) {
170      pin.setLocation(new edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.pojo.Location(
171          location.getLatitude(), location.getLongitude()));
172    }
173    // TODO: 2/18/25 Set/modify the createdOn/modifiedOn.
174    pinViewModel.savePin(pin);
175    dismiss();
176  }
177
178  /**
179   * Handles the provided URI by updating the associated image and displaying it in the UI.
180   *
181   * @param uri the URI of the image to be handled. If the URI is null, the method does nothing.
182   */
183  private void handleCaptureUri(Uri uri) {
184    if (uri != null) {
185      this.uri = uri;
186      pin.setImage(uri);
187      binding.image.setImageURI(uri);
188      binding.image.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
189    }
190  }
191
192  /**
193   * Updates the UI elements with the details of the provided pin object.
194   *
195   * The method performs the following:
196   * - Assigns the input pin to the class-level pin variable.
197   * - Sets the title and content in the UI using the title and content values of the pin.
198   * - Updates the image view based on the image URI:
199   *   - If the image URI is not null, the image is displayed and made visible.
200   *   - If the image URI is null, the image view is hidden.
201   *
202   * @param pin the pin object whose details are to be displayed in the UI.
203   */
204  private void handlePin(Pin pin) {
205    this.pin = pin;
206    binding.title.setText(pin.getTitle());
207    binding.content.setText(pin.getContent());
208    Uri imageURI = pin.getImage();
209    if (imageURI != null) {
210      binding.image.setImageURI(imageURI);
211      binding.image.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
212    } else {
213      binding.image.setVisibility(View.GONE);
214    }
215    uri = imageURI;
216  }
217
218  @ColorInt
219  private int getThemeColor(int colorAttr) {
220    TypedValue typedValue = new TypedValue();
221    requireContext().getTheme().resolveAttribute(colorAttr, typedValue, true);
222    return typedValue.data;
223  }
224
225  /**
226   * Initiates the process of capturing an image and storing its reference for later use.
227   *
228   * The method performs the following steps:
229   * 1. Retrieves the application context to access the file system.
230   * 2. Ensures the existence of the directory designed to store captured images.
231   * 3. Generates a unique filename for the captured image to avoid conflicts.
232   * 4. Obtains a URI for the created file using the application's FileProvider infrastructure.
233   * 5. Sets the generated URI as a pending capture URI in the ViewModel.
234   * 6. Launches the capture process using the capture launcher.
235   *
236   * The generated URI is used to save the captured image, and the ViewModel stores it for further handling.
237   */
238  private void capture() {
239    Context context = requireContext();
240    File captureDir = new File(context.getFilesDir(), getString(R.string.capture_directory)); // Using the context, get a reference to the directory where we store captured images.
241    //noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
242    captureDir.mkdir(); // Ensure that the directory exists.
243    // TODO: 2/24/25 Genetrate a random filename for captured image.
244    File captureFile;
245    do {
246      captureFile = new File(captureDir, UUID.randomUUID().toString());
247    } while (captureFile.exists());
248    Uri uri = FileProvider.getUriForFile(context, AUTHORITY, captureFile); // Get a URI for the random file, using the provider infrastructure.
249    pinViewModel.setPendingCaptureUri(uri); // Store the URI in the viewmodel.
250    captureLauncher.launch(uri); // Launch the capture launcher.
251  }
252
253}
